title: Function-field reconstruction from Milnor K-theory and Galois data

result.label: Function-field reconstruction from Milnor K-theory and Galois data
result.statement: Reconstructs function fields of transcendence degree at least two over algebraically closed constants from K^ M 1/ , K^ M 2/ , and their product. These data recover the perfect closure and constants when ℓ differs from the characteristic, and the original field and its named base in equal characteristic. Also proves Bogomolov–Pop reconstruction from abelian-by-central pro- ℓ Galois data away from the characteristic.
